caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a decorative border and a central scene. The border features an alternating pattern of large leaves and stylized birds that resemble eagles with outstretched wings, each holding a shield with vertical stripes. The inner rim of the plate contains a scrollwork design framing a central image. Within this central area, there is a detailed illustration showing a waterfront scene with a large sailing ship and several smaller boats on calm water. On the shore in the foreground, several figures are gathered, some appearing to engage in conversation or gestures, while in the background there are multiple buildings with gabled roofs and chimneys, as well as trees or hills behind them. The drawing is presented in monochrome, using varying shades of gray to indicate texture, shading, and depth throughout the composition.
title: Fruit Dish - "Quebec"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
